purpose: Express regret about an unrealized better choice.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
I should have left a little earlier.
I wish I had bought the larger size.
I should not have sent that email.
restrictions: Usually looks back on an action taken or not taken.
mistake: Use なければよかった to regret doing something.
